load_voc_instances: load Pascal VOC detection annotations from a dataset directory into Detectron2 format dicts
register_pascal_voc: register a Pascal VOC dataset split in Detectron2 DatasetCatalog with metadata
load_pascal_voc_train: load Pascal VOC training instances from a directory with train split and default 20 class names
register_pascal_voc_split: register a Pascal VOC dataset split with custom name, directory, split type, and year
load_pascal_voc_instances: load Pascal VOC test or validation instances with a custom class names list
